title: 1smv2m9
Panj-i Al-i Aba (the Incident of the Cloak): Who are the Ahl al-Bayt?
hook: One morning, five people under a cloak. The Prophet calls them "my Ahl al-Bayt." Who are these five?
scenes.0.text: One morning in Medina the Prophet came out wearing a black woolen cloak. First **Imam Hasan** came. The Prophet took him under the cloak. Then **Imam Husayn**, **Lady Fatima** and **Imam Ali** came. He gathered the five under the same cloak. "O Ahl al-Bayt, God only wants to remove impurity from you and to purify you completely." This saying is Ahzâb 33:33. The verse was revealed over the cloak, for these five people.

scenes.1.text: The same morning, beside the cloak, the Prophet prayed: "O God, these are my Ahl al-Bayt. Remove impurity from them and purify them completely." Umm Salama asked, "Am I with them?" The Prophet said, "You are on the good." He did not take her under the cloak. Only those five remained under the cloak.

scenes.2.text: The Verse of Purification speaks of the five taken under the cloak. Tathir means purification. Ahl in the verse means household. The Prophet recited the verse over them. The purification is their being protected from sin. This is called ==isma==. Imamate, that is the leadership of the imams, rests on this purity.
scenes.2.art.actors.0.label: 19izoul
The Prophet
scenes.3.text: Zayd b. Arqam was asked who the Ahl al-Bayt are. He kept the wives outside this close circle. He mentioned the families of Ali, Aqil, Ja'far and Abbas. The five under the cloak are at the center of this circle of kin.
scenes.3.art.actors.1.label: 19izoul
The Prophet
scenes.4.text: These five are called **Panj-i Al-i Aba**. Panj means five. Al-i Aba means the family of the cloak. They are the Prophet, **Imam Ali**, **Lady Fatima**, **Imam Hasan** and **Imam Husayn**. The open hand on the banners is the lovers carrying these five on their chests.

scenes.5.text: According to the report there is a longer account from **Lady Fatima**. Its name is the Hadith al-Kisa. Kisa means cloak. In this account the address of Gabriel and of God is also heard under the cloak. These five are not only the people of a house. That address names them the Ahl al-Bayt.

scenes.6.text: The Hadith al-Kisa shows that God determined the core of the ==Ahl al-Bayt==. The core is the five under the cloak. The later imams come from the lineage of these five. Imamate rests on these five people. At Ghadir the Prophet will raise **Imam Ali**'s hand from among these five before everyone.

sunni.0.says: Aisha: the Prophet takes Imam Hasan, Imam Husayn, Fatima and Imam Ali under a black cloak and recites Ahzâb 33:33.
sunni.1.says: The Prophet prays for those under the cloak, "these are my Ahl al-Bayt"; Umm Salama asks, "and I?"
sunni.2.says: The scope of the Ahl al-Bayt: the families to whom zakat is forbidden; the wives are in the debate over this scope.
shia.0.says: The chains of the Kisa incident in Shia and Sunni sources; the relation of the long Hadith al-Kisa.
shia.1.says: The isma interpretation of Ahzâb 33:33 and the scope of the Ahl al-Bayt.
disputes.0.title: 1ayy4z2
The scope of the Ahl al-Bayt
disputes.0.sunni: The Prophet took Imam Ali, Lady Fatima, Imam Hasan and Imam Husayn under the cloak and recited Ahzâb 33:33. In the Sunni reading the scope is wider; the wives and the Banu Hashim also belong to the Ahl al-Bayt, the Kisa circle is the core, and the verse is among the verses addressing the wives.
disputes.0.shia: The Prophet took Imam Ali, Lady Fatima, Imam Hasan and Imam Husayn under the cloak and recited Ahzâb 33:33. In the Shia view the Verse of Purification and the Kisa hadith limit the Ahl al-Bayt who possess isma to the Prophet, Imam Ali, Lady Fatima, Imam Hasan and Imam Husayn; the imams are of their lineage.
disputes.1.title: rfcilz
Umm Salama and the cloak
disputes.1.sunni: The Prophet did not take Umm Salama under the cloak and said to her, "You are on the good." In the Sunni reading this saying does not exclude her; it announces that she is on goodness and does not remove the view that the wives are counted among the Ahl al-Bayt.
disputes.1.shia: The Prophet did not take Umm Salama under the cloak and said to her, "You are on the good." In the Shia view, his not taking her under the cloak and keeping her apart shows that the verse specially means the five who possess isma.
questions.0: The Prophet gathered five people under a cloak. How does this picture grow love for the Ahl al-Bayt within you?
questions.1: Zayd b. Arqam described the Ahl al-Bayt as the Prophet's close family. What does this saying add to your love for that family?
questions.2: The Verse of Purification says "to purify you completely." The Shia read this as protection from sin. How does this purity nourish the trust you feel in them?
summary: The Prophet took Imam Ali, Lady Fatima, Imam Hasan and Imam Husayn under the cloak and named them the Ahl al-Bayt. These five are Panj-i Al-i Aba and, in the Shia view, the core of the Ahl al-Bayt who possess isma.
key: Panj-i Al-i Aba: the five lights under the cloak
notes.0: The Kisa incident is related from Aisha in Muslim 2424.
notes.1: The Prophet took Imam Ali, Lady Fatima, Imam Hasan and Imam Husayn under a black cloak.
notes.2: Then he recited the verse «God only wants to remove impurity from you, O Ahl al-Bayt» (Ahzâb 33:33).
notes.3: These five are called «Panj-i Al-i Aba» (the five of the people of the cloak).
notes.4: These five under the cloak are the core of the Ahl al-Bayt in the Ja'fari school. The common account is these five people.
